title: QUIC connection migration CID retirement packet desynchronization under high packet loss
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0637: QUIC connection migration CID retirement packet desynchronization under high packet loss
Repository: `cloudflare/quiche`
Category: `High-Throughput Network Protocols`
Target File: `quiche/src/connection.rs`

#### Problem Description
Server retires connection ID while client flight packets still in transit, triggering spurious CONNECTION_CLOSE.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Retain retired CID in tombstone table for 3 PTO (Probe Timeout) durations before purging.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0637.py -q`
expected_invariant: Retain retired CID in tombstone table for 3 PTO (Probe Timeout) durations before purging.
